interest: Index on Japan's 1941 plan for Taiwanese voluntary military service.
overview: Docket (1941): Grew reports Japan's cabinet plans voluntary military service in Taiwan, modeled on Korea's 1938 system.

subfiles.about: A Department of State docket sheet recording a 1941 telegram from Ambassador Joseph C. Grew regarding Japanese Cabinet plans to introduce voluntary military service in Taiwan.
subfiles.summary: Indexes a 1941 Grew telegram on Japan's cabinet decision for voluntary military service in Taiwan, modeled on Korea's 1938 system.
